# descope_splunk_on_call_connector (Resource)

Manages a Splunk On-Call connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Trigger and resolve Splunk On-Call (formerly VictorOps) incidents from a Descope flow.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The REST Endpoint integration key, from Integrations > REST Endpoint in Splunk On-Call.
- `base_url` (String) Splunk On-Call alert ingestion base URL.
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `routing_key` (String) Default routing key, from Settings > Routing Keys. An action can override it.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
